programmes.d: Ann's father slips and hurts himself, and Donald has to get him to sign an insurance waiver.
Sportscaster Howard Cosell, in a neat bit of type-casting, plays Howard Cosell, a famous sportscaster who becomes involved in a feud with Oscar Madison.
In The Princess, Miss Simmons plays Lydia of Lichtenstein who visits Felix's studio for a portrait sitting and meets Oscar, who, unaware of her station, tries to date her.
Felix decides to become a writer and Oscar thinks he's wasting his time and money.
Oscar tries to cover up his divorce from his visiting mother by moving Felix out and ex-wife Blanche.
Felix is given an opportunity to direct a razor commercial on television, provided that he gets Deacon Jones to appear in it.
Cindy’s lead role in a school play causes a family crisis.
Alice doesn't think the boys need her as much anymore now that Carol is in the house--so she announces that she is leaving.
Mike and Carol plan a camping trip for the whole family.
Carol gets laryngitis right before singing at the Christmas service.
Marcia nominates Mike for a Father of the Year award.
The Bradys comb the neighborhood in search of runaway dog Tiger.
A stray dog that follows Ann home decides to bite her visiting father.
While shopping, Ann becomes sympathetic to an eight-year-old boy who tries to steal a candy bar.
The United States Air Force hires Ann to recruit women to the WAFS for potential space travel.
A lonely night at Ann's apartment is interrupted by a mouse.
After inviting her parents over to a baseball game that gets rained out, Ann decides to let them and Donald stay at her place for a game of Monopoly.

Mike and the kids run the house while Carol is out of town.
Marcia becomes convinced she's ugly, ugly, ugly! after having to wear braces.
Peter’s ego inflates after saving a girl from an accident.
The kids are at each others' throats. The basic cause of the problem is that the house is seemingly too small with six kids sharing two bedrooms and one bathroom.
Jan gets a locket from a secret admirer. As the family try to determine who anonymously sent the locket, they're momentarily distracted when Jan loses the locket.
Greg wants to quit school to become a major league pitcher.
While modeling, Ann is hired to spy on a competitor who is suspected of stealing designs.
Ann's cover is blown and she is tricked into photographing rejected dress designs.
Ann is directing a play back at home in Brewster and has to tell her father that he's not getting the starring role.
Ann gets a job at a restaurant as a dancing chicken.
Under hypnosis at the dentist (guest star Monty Hall), Ann is mistakenly told to buy anything at the drop of a hat at the same time Donald is trying to help her work on a budget.
Oscar tells Myrna the story of why Felix has been banned from Midtown Memorial Hospital ever since his daughter's birth in The First Baby.
Felix plans a surprise birthday party for Oscar -who loathes birthday parties.
Allen invites Oscar to be a celebrity contestant on his ABC show, and eager Felix persuades him to accept the offer and to take him along as his partner.
Felix turns to Oscar for help after complaining he no longer can communicate with his daughter.
When Oscar's ulcer begins acting up, Felix decides an ocean voyage will do them both good.
